% Pattern: manual/bold/article and environment/newtheorem*. A bold head whose
% number is followed by a citation in brackets, as "Lemma 1[6,9]", a numbered
% claim head on a line after a sentence inside a proof, and a starred
% environment titled with the names of the authors of a theorem.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want head-1 statement/lemma 1
% want proof-1 proof -
% want head-2 statement/claim 2
% want bl-1 statement/theorem -
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem*{bl}{Smith--Jones}
\begin{document}

\noindent{\bf Lemma 1[6,9]} {\it Let $G$ be a graph. Then $G$ has a vertex.}

\begin{proof}
The graph is finite, and the vertex set is not empty.\\
{\bf Claim 2.}~The set has a least element.
It is finite.
\end{proof}

\begin{bl}
Let $k\geq 1$. Then the set is not empty.
\end{bl}
\end{document}
